limitations: The published branch carries only reference artifacts; production/runtime source remains at the pinned base. Tests exercised separately reconstructed candidate trees, not runtime changes on the handoff branch.

Source checks on the six-patch tree and final seven-patch configuration/repository checks retain distinct exact tree identities. No fresh full browser, Compose/live-provider or installed-distribution qualification is claimed.

Generator OpenPGP signing-agent test was skipped because gpg-agent could not start; the new core offline public-key OpenPGP regression passed. Host Python/Node patch versions differ from the pinned mise baseline.

The mailto/history defect has a reference fix; credential-bearing HTTPS source/renderer policy remains an explicit unresolved decision. Signature armor and direct-helper size restrictions need historical-compatibility review.

Private-root retention/fencing, RC version mapping, repository protection settings and the frozen v1 corpus are design proposals. No corresponding production gate, infrastructure change, release, or compatibility promise has been implemented by this handoff.
Existing issue #64 and draft PR #79 remain implementation context. Owner-deferred spoken screen-reader qualification in #9 is not promoted to a blocker.
